verdict.rationale: Helicone is API-first, so it can be driven without a UI. Its AI Gateway is used through the OpenAI SDK, a REST query API is documented with curl examples, an OpenAPI spec is published, webhooks automate workflows, and Docker Compose supports scripted self-hosting. None of this evidence is framed around CI pipelines, and there is no CLI. Missing for 10: an official CLI, CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented headless prompt/eval automation in pipelines, and independent hands-on reports of CI use.
